(c) Stockholder Approval. The Company Stockholder Approval shall been duly obtained in accordance with applicable Law, the Company Charter and the Company By-laws at the Company Stockholder Meeting.

(b) Performance of Obligations of the Company. The Company will have performed and complied with, in all material respects, its agreements, obligations and covenants required to be performed by it under this Agreement at or prior to the Effective Time.
(c) No Company Material Adverse Effect. Since the date of this Agreement, there shall not have occurred any Company Material Adverse Effect that is continuing.
(d) Closing Certificate.
